title: Sticky Sesame Cauliflower Salad
subtitle: with Mixed Grains and Lettuce Cups
description: Stir-fry baked cauli florets in a honey and soy mix, toss veggies in a nutty rice blend and pile into lettuce cups. It's up to you how to eat them: as a salad or as wraps with no cutlery required!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for grain blend. Cut the cauliflower into small florets. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Cut the capsicum into 1cm chunks, discarding the seeds and membrane. Thinly slice the spring onion.

Roast cauliflower: Put 2 tsp sesame seeds, 1½ tbs plain flour and 1½ tbs water in a large bowl. Season with pepper and whisk to combine. Add the cauliflower and toss to coat. Spread over the lined tray in a single layer and roast for 18-20 mins until lightly golden and tender.

Make grain blend salad: Meanwhile, cook the grain blend in the pan of boiling water for 20-22 mins until tender. Drain, then return the grain blend to the pan with the carrot, capsicum, spring onion, 1 tbs olive oil and 1 tsp white vinegar. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine.

Toss sticky cauliflower: Put the remaining sesame seeds, 1 tbs soy sauce, 2 tsp tomato paste, ½ tsp white vinegar, 1 tbs water and 1 tsp honey in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Bring to a simmer, then cook for 2-3 mins until thickened. Add the cauliflower and toss to coat. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Separate the lettuce leaves and divide among plates. Top with the grain salad and sticky cauliflower and enjoy as lettuce cups or a salad.
Make it yours: Add a fresh flavour hit with a scattering of sliced coriander or mint leaves.
